wallet.caption: Your wallet at a glance
wallet.alt: Sovran wallet with balance, transaction history, and Send and Receive controls.
wallet.purpose: Introduce the wallet home and its payment entry points.
wallet.state: Wallet overview; store captures use presentation fixtures, not proof of real funds.

contacts.caption: People and mints in one place
contacts.alt: Sovran contacts list with people and mint entries.
contacts.purpose: Show where to find a contact before opening a conversation.

ai.caption: Chat with an AI model
ai.alt: Sovran AI chat screen with conversation and model controls.
ai.purpose: Introduce AI chat without claiming a paid inference completed.
ai.state: Presentation conversation, not payment or service availability evidence.

ai-model-picker.caption: Choose a model for your chat
ai-model-picker.alt: Model selection menu open over Sovran AI chat.
ai-model-picker.purpose: Pair model choice with the chat screen.
ai-model-picker.state: Model-picker overlay open; this is not a separate canonical page.

lightning-receive.caption: Present a Lightning invoice
lightning-receive.alt: Lightning receive screen displaying an invoice QR code.
lightning-receive.purpose: Show an amount-specific invoice, distinct from the standing receive QR.
lightning-receive.state: Presentation mint quote reopened from transaction history; a screenshot does not establish payment settlement.

receive-qr.caption: Share a standing receive code
receive-qr.alt: Unified tab of the Sovran receive QR screen.
receive-qr.purpose: Show the Unified receive surface, not a confirmed P2PK-locked request.
receive-qr.state: Unified tab selected; included methods depend on configured mints and receive settings.

receive-qr-p2pk.caption: Request ecash locked to your key
receive-qr-p2pk.alt: Cashu receive QR screen with the P2PK lock option enabled.
receive-qr-p2pk.purpose: Pair a receiving key with the Cashu payment-request lock control.
receive-qr-p2pk.state: Cashu tab after receive-creq-p2pk-state:1 is visible; the request asks for a P2PK lock, not proof of payment or settlement.

settings-keyring.caption: Manage your receiving keys
settings-keyring.alt: P2PK Keys settings showing two keys after generating an additional key.
settings-keyring.purpose: Explain key management alongside a key-locked Cashu receive request.
settings-keyring.state: After YOUR KEYS (2); the scenario first waits for YOUR KEYS (1), then generates an additional key.

send.caption: Choose how to send
send.alt: Sovran Send menu with payment method choices.
send.purpose: Show the entry to a payment, before an amount or confirmation.
send.state: Send method hub open; no payment has been submitted.

mint-select.caption: Choose a mint
mint-select.alt: Mint selector listing the wallet's mints.
mint-select.purpose: Introduce mint choice before inspecting trust and capabilities.
mint-select.state: Mint selection list open from the wallet.

mint-info.caption: Inspect a mint before using it
mint-info.alt: Mint information screen with details about the selected mint.
mint-info.purpose: Support an informed mint choice, not imply a safety guarantee.

mint-reviews.caption: Read community mint reviews
mint-reviews.alt: Community reviews for a mint in Sovran.
mint-reviews.purpose: Place community feedback alongside mint details.
mint-reviews.state: Reviews list; content depends on the selected mint and available network data.

notification-mint-changes.caption: Follow changes to your mints
notification-mint-changes.purpose: Show ongoing mint awareness after choosing a mint.
notification-mint-changes.state: Mint updates list; not evidence that a mint is safe or solvent.

notifications.caption: Catch up on activity
notifications.alt: Sovran notifications screen with activity entries.
notifications.state: Notifications overview in the marketing presentation flow.

feed.caption: Explore your Nostr feed
feed.alt: Sovran social feed displaying Nostr posts.
feed.purpose: Show the social reading surface before opening a thread.
feed.state: Presentation feed; no publishing is performed by the capture flow.

thread.caption: Follow the conversation
thread.alt: Nostr post thread with replies in Sovran.
thread.purpose: Pair the feed with a focused discussion.
thread.state: Thread reader; render only when a reviewed capture is available.

dm-chat.caption: Open a direct conversation
dm-chat.purpose: Connect the contacts list to one-to-one messaging.
dm-chat.state: Presentation conversation; no message is sent by the capture flow.

stories.caption: View a story
stories.purpose: Show a media-focused companion to the social feed.
stories.state: Story viewer; media availability is required for a usable capture.

image-viewer.caption: See media in detail
image-viewer.purpose: Show a post's image full screen, opened from the demo thread.
image-viewer.state: Image viewer over the demo thread with the bundled local copy of the post's image; captured after the full-size image loads.

settings.caption: Make the wallet yours
settings.purpose: Introduce preferences and the entry to security key management.
settings.state: Settings root, not the P2PK keyring page.

theme-preview.caption: Preview your wallet's appearance
theme-preview.alt: Wallpaper preview cards for wallet units in Sovran.
theme-preview.state: Per-unit wallpaper previews before choosing an album image.

gallery.caption: Choose a wallpaper from an album
gallery.purpose: Connect an album selection with the resulting wallet appearance.
gallery.state: Wallpaper gallery open in the appearance flow.

wallet-appearance.caption: A wallet with your chosen wallpaper
wallet-appearance.alt: Sovran wallet with a selected color or photographic wallpaper.
wallet-appearance.purpose: Pair wallpaper choice with its applied appearance; wallpaperId identifies the variant.
wallet-appearance.state: Wallet after a wallpaper selection; balance and controls remain wallet content.

backup-words.caption: Back up your wallet carefully
backup-words.alt: Wallet recovery-word backup screen in a disposable test wallet.
backup-words.purpose: Explain the backup step; never publish a real user's recovery words.
backup-words.state: Candidate from a disposable fresh-install wallet. Manual privacy review is mandatory before retention.

collections.title: From wallet to payment
collections.description: The wallet overview, send choices, and standing receive code. These are entry and request screens, not settlement proof.

collections.title: Keys and locked receive requests
collections.description: Pair key management with the Cashu request lock control. Both captures are unavailable until a native run is imported and reviewed; this is a conceptual pairing, not one continuous captured session.

collections.title: Choose and follow a mint
collections.description: Mint selection, details, community reviews, and updates help explain the trust decision without guaranteeing a mint's safety.

collections.title: People and conversations
collections.description: Move from the feed or contacts to a focused conversation. Missing captures remain unavailable.

collections.title: Choose a model and chat
collections.description: Pair the model-picker overlay with the AI conversation surface.

collections.title: Choose a look for your wallet
collections.description: Preview, browse an album, then see the selected wallpaper on the wallet.
